title: The Matrix
logline: A hacker named Neo is offered a choice between a red and blue pill by a man named Morpheus, leading him to discover he is a battery in a machine world.
premise: Neo must choose between ignorance and truth, and his belief in the prophecy is the only variable that allows him to override the simulation's rules, pitting his faith against the Agents' deterministic control. The central dilemma is whether truth is worth the suffering: Cypher argues that ignorance is bliss (blue pill), while Neo argues that even painful truth is preferable to comfortable lies (red pill). Neo's strength is his latent ability to believe (which allows him to override the Matrix), but his vulnerability is his chronic doubt (which prevents him from accessing it until he makes a selfless choice).

audience.reader_promise: A visceral action thriller that uses the simulation concept to externalize Neo's internal struggle with identity and agency, where the 'correct' choice is validated only through his willingness to believe.

rules_of_the_world: The Matrix is a neural-interactive simulation that can be hacked via the Construct.
Agents are sentient programs that can possess any human body within the Matrix.
Death in the Matrix results in death in the real world.
The One can bend or break the rules of the simulation through belief.
Humans are grown in power plants to serve as biological batteries for the machines.
